raw.markdown:
# Varicocelectomy — Authorization Guide

CPT Codes · ICD-10 · Payer Requirements

(backHref: /varicocelectomy)

## CPT Codes

| CPT | Description | Approach |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 55530 | Excision of varicocele or ligation of spermatic veins for varicocele; (separate procedure) | Open/Laparoscopic |
| 55535 | Excision of varicocele or ligation of spermatic veins for varicocele; abdominal approach | Open abdominal |
| 55540 | Excision of varicocele or ligation of spermatic veins for varicocele; with hernia repair | Open + hernia |
| 37241 | Vascular embolization or occlusion, inclusive of all radiological supervision and interpretation, intraprocedural roadmapping, and imaging guidance necessary to complete the intervention; venous, other than hemorrhage (e.g., congenital or acquired venous malformations, venous and capillary hemangiomas, varices, varicoceles) | Percutaneous embolization |
| 74185 | Magnetic resonance angiography, abdomen, with or without contrast material(s) | Diagnostic MRI |
| 93971 | Duplex scan of extremity veins including responses to compression and other maneuvers; unilateral or limited study | Scrotal Doppler |

## ICD-10 Diagnoses

| ICD-10 | Description |
| --- | --- |
| I86.1 | Scrotal varices (varicocele) |
| N46.11 | Organic oligospermia |
| N46.121 | Oligospermia due to obstruction of efferent ducts |
| N46.129 | Oligospermia due to other extratesticular causes |
| N46.8 | Other male infertility |
| N46.9 | Male infertility, unspecified |
| N50.89 | Other specified disorders of male genital organs |
| Z31.81 | Encounter for male factor infertility in female patient |

## Coverage Landscape

### Common Denial Reasons

- "Infertility treatment" blanket exclusion
- "Not medically necessary" for subclinical varicocele
- Lack of documentation of abnormal semen parameters
- Female partner fertility evaluation not completed

### Strongest Coverage Arguments

- AUA/ASRM Grade A evidence for palpable varicocele + abnormal semen + infertility
- Varicocele is a diagnosable vascular condition (I86.1), not merely infertility treatment
- Pain indication (N50.89) is a non-infertility medical indication
- Adolescent testicular atrophy prevention is a non-infertility indication
- State infertility mandates in 15+ states

## Prior Authorization Requirements

### Required Documentation

- ≥2 semen analyses confirming oligospermia/asthenospermia/teratospermia
- Physical examination confirming palpable varicocele (grade I–III)
- Scrotal Doppler ultrasound report
- Hormonal profile: FSH, LH, testosterone
- Duration of infertility (≥12 months)
- Female partner fertility evaluation results
- Letter of medical necessity from urologist/reproductive specialist

### AUA/ASRM Medical Necessity Criteria (Grade A)

All three criteria must be met for Grade A recommendation:

1. Palpable varicocele (Grade I–III on physical exam)
2. Abnormal semen parameters (concentration <16M/mL, motility <30%, morphology <4%, or TMC <9M)
3. ≥12 months of infertility with female partner whose fertility evaluation is normal or treatable
